messages:
sam: Canary in eu-central failed during postInstall - cert-init container stuck in ImagePullBackOff for billing-chart v3.2.0. noticed after deploy-bot promoted from staging -> canary. :frowning:

deploy-bot: promotion status: canary failed for release billing-release (chart v3.2.0). failed check: pod/cert-init - ImagePullBackOff. holding further promotions.

lee: is this the private reg change? last commit bumped image tag to `registry.internal/billing-cert:2026-03-18` and we rotated read-only creds yesterday.

kristin: QA saw a flaky init order earlier when redis isn't ready. values change `global.initOrder: staggered` was added in 3.2.0. could be a race between cert-init and redis init.

sam: pulling pod events: `Failed to pull image "registry.internal/billing-cert:2026-03-18": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = unauthorized`

lee: that looks like a creds problem, not ordering. @sre-oncall any reg changes?

sre-oncall: rotated robot account keys at 2026-03-18 02:12 UTC but should have been propagated. checking image pull logs across nodes.

qa-bot: canary test run aborted: saw 503s during init window, test-suite id 9876, failing step: tls handshake to payment-gateway.

kristin: options: 1) rollback chart to v3.1.5 (last known good) 2) manually pin the canary pool to the previous image tag and re-run canary 3) unpin and force redeploy after creds propagation.

lee: rolling back seems safest given it's outside of overnight window for billing. but if it's just creds we could restart image pull retry after propagation. downside: manual pin would be awkward with deploy-bot auto-promote rules.

sam: note: deploy-bot will auto-promote once canary passes. if we do a manual image re-tag on the cluster it may still pick up v3.2.0 when next promotion triggers. we should annotate namespace to prevent auto-promote while we triage.

sre-oncall: agree. set `release-management/hold: true` on namespace and annotate `release-management/pinned-chart=v3.1.5` if we rollback. I'll also re-sync robot creds to nodes.

lee: command snippets:
```
# set hold
kubectl annotate namespace billing-canary release-management/hold=true --overwrite
# rollback
helm rollback billing-release 5 --namespace billing-canary
kubectl annotate namespace billing-canary release-management/pinned-chart=v3.1.5 --overwrite
```

kristin: FYI the changelog generator will pick up the rollback annotation and add an automated entry unless you add a manual note. Please add a brief release-note explaining why to avoid accidental re-promote.

sam: I'll put a short note in #changelog: "Reverted billing-chart to v3.1.5 due to image-pull auth failure for cert-init in v3.2.0. Hold in place until robot creds fully propagated and init order verified."

deploy-bot: manual action recorded: rollback requested by @sam for release billing-release -> target chart v3.1.5. Promotion hold applied.

lee: performing rollback now. will ping when canary is green or if we need to escalate. :construction_worker:

deploy-bot: helm rollback successful. release billing-release -> v3.1.5. Promotion hold remains.

sre-oncall: creds re-sync in progress; I'll post once nodes report successful pull of `registry.internal/billing-cert:2026-03-18` so we can try a patched 3.2.0 canary with added preflight checks.

kristin: follow-up action: PR to add imagePullSecrets check in postRender preflight + revert `global.initOrder` change to be opt-in behind feature flag. assigning to @kristin. ETA EOD.

sam: thanks. once PR merged, we'll run a targeted canary in the small pool and remove the hold after a clean run.

qa-bot: reminder: schedule re-run outside peak hours; previous flakiness impacted nightly jobs.

sre-oncall: monitoring. if any latency spike during rollback, I'll raise incident channel. so far metrics look stable.
